title: Fine Sound Control
description: Control the volume of individual sounds.
body: Control the volume of individual sounds. Changes can be made locally to the current save/server, or globally to all saves and servers. Local sound changes take priority over global sound changes. Help Command: `/fsc help` - Shows this help message. `/fsc enable/disable` - Enables or disables the mod. `/fsc listen` - Prints the ID of every new sound you hear to the chat. Run the command again to disable. `/fsc list` - List all sound modifications. By default, all changes will apply only to the current save/server. To make a change for all saves and servers, add `global` to the end of the command. `/fsc set "[sound]" [volume]` - Sets the volume of a sound. `/fsc mute "[sound]"` - Mutes a sound. `/fsc reset "[sound]"` - Delete any modifications to a sound. `/fsc clear {global/local}` - Delete all sound modifications. `[sound]` should match the ID from the listen command, enclosed in quotation marks. `[volume]` should be a value between 0 and 1. ### Issues You can submit issues on [Github](https://github.com/SoundsoftheSun/fine-sound-control/issues) or [Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/SoundsoftheSun/fine-sound-control/issues) ### Translation Most of my downloads come from countries where English is not the primary language! If you want to help translate any of my mods to your language, you can go to https://translate.soundsofthesun.net/projects and sign in with github to contribute!
